question: What Is the Difference Between Point to Point and Multidrop Connection?
body_html:
Point to point connection uses a dedicated link between only two devices, while a multidrop connection lets one sender talk to several devices on one shared line using addresses.

FeaturePoint to pointMultidrop
Devices on linkTwoMany on one line
BandwidthFull channel for one pairShared by all devices
Data deliveryDirect, no addressing neededEach device checks the address
CablingOne cable per deviceLess cable, one trunk
